nodes.Name: Node
nodes.DocComment:
A Node is an element in the parse tree. The interface is trivial.
The interface contains an unexported method so that only
types local to this package can satisfy it.

nodes.Name: NodeType
nodes.DocComment: NodeType identifies the type of a parse tree node.

nodes.Name: Pos
nodes.DocComment:
Pos represents a byte position in the original input text from which
this template was parsed.

nodes.Name: Type
nodes.DocComment:
Type returns itself and provides an easy default implementation
for embedding in a Node. Embedded in all non-trivial Nodes.

nodes.Name: ListNode
nodes.DocComment: ListNode holds a sequence of nodes.

Fields.Name: Nodes
Fields.DocComment: The element nodes in lexical order.

nodes.Name: TextNode
nodes.DocComment: TextNode holds plain text.

nodes.Name: CommentNode
nodes.DocComment: CommentNode holds a comment.

nodes.Name: PipeNode
nodes.DocComment: PipeNode holds a pipeline with optional declaration

Fields.Name: Line
Fields.DocComment: The line number in the input. Deprecated: Kept for compatibility.

Fields.Name: IsAssign
Fields.DocComment: The variables are being assigned, not declared.

nodes.Name: ActionNode
nodes.DocComment:
ActionNode holds an action (something bounded by delimiters).
Control actions have their own nodes; ActionNode represents simple
ones such as field evaluations and parenthesized pipelines.

Fields.Name: Line
Fields.DocComment: The line number in the input. Deprecated: Kept for compatibility.

nodes.Name: CommandNode
nodes.DocComment: CommandNode holds a command (a pipeline inside an evaluating action).

Fields.Name: Args
Fields.DocComment: Arguments in lexical order: Identifier, field, or constant.

nodes.Name: IdentifierNode
nodes.DocComment: IdentifierNode holds an identifier.

nodes.Name: NewIdentifier
nodes.DocComment: NewIdentifier returns a new [IdentifierNode] with the given identifier name.

nodes.Name: SetPos
nodes.DocComment:
SetPos sets the position. [NewIdentifier] is a public method so we can't modify its signature.
Chained for convenience.
TODO: fix one day?

nodes.Name: SetTree
nodes.DocComment:
SetTree sets the parent tree for the node. [NewIdentifier] is a public method so we can't modify its signature.
Chained for convenience.
TODO: fix one day?

nodes.Name: VariableNode
nodes.DocComment:
VariableNode holds a list of variable names, possibly with chained field
accesses. The dollar sign is part of the (first) name.

Fields.Name: Ident
Fields.DocComment: Variable name and fields in lexical order.

nodes.Name: DotNode
nodes.DocComment: DotNode holds the special identifier '.'.

nodes.Name: NilNode
nodes.DocComment: NilNode holds the special identifier 'nil' representing an untyped nil constant.

nodes.Name: FieldNode
nodes.DocComment:
FieldNode holds a field (identifier starting with '.').
The names may be chained ('.x.y').
The period is dropped from each ident.

nodes.Name: ChainNode
nodes.DocComment:
ChainNode holds a term followed by a chain of field accesses (identifier starting with '.').
The names may be chained ('.x.y').
The periods are dropped from each ident.

nodes.Name: Add
nodes.DocComment: Add adds the named field (which should start with a period) to the end of the chain.

nodes.Name: BoolNode
nodes.DocComment: BoolNode holds a boolean constant.

Fields.Name: True
Fields.DocComment: The value of the boolean constant.

nodes.Name: NumberNode
nodes.DocComment:
NumberNode holds a number: signed or unsigned integer, float, or complex.
The value is parsed and stored under all the types that can represent the value.
This simulates in a small amount of code the behavior of Go's ideal constants.

Fields.Name: IsUint
Fields.DocComment: Number has an unsigned integral value.

Fields.Name: Text
Fields.DocComment: The original textual representation from the input.

nodes.Name: simplifyComplex
nodes.DocComment:
simplifyComplex pulls out any other types that are represented by the complex number.
These all require that the imaginary part be zero.

nodes.Name: StringNode
nodes.DocComment: StringNode holds a string constant. The value has been "unquoted".

Fields.Name: Quoted
Fields.DocComment: The original text of the string, with quotes.

nodes.Name: endNode
nodes.DocComment:
endNode represents an {{end}} action.
It does not appear in the final parse tree.

nodes.Name: elseNode
nodes.DocComment: elseNode represents an {{else}} action. Does not appear in the final tree.

Fields.Name: Line
Fields.DocComment: The line number in the input. Deprecated: Kept for compatibility.

nodes.Name: BranchNode
nodes.DocComment: BranchNode is the common representation of if, range, and with.

Fields.Name: Line
Fields.DocComment: The line number in the input. Deprecated: Kept for compatibility.

Fields.Name: List
Fields.DocComment: What to execute if the value is non-empty.

Fields.Name: ElseList
Fields.DocComment: What to execute if the value is empty (nil if absent).

nodes.Name: IfNode
nodes.DocComment: IfNode represents an {{if}} action and its commands.

nodes.Name: BreakNode
nodes.DocComment: BreakNode represents a {{break}} action.

nodes.Name: ContinueNode
nodes.DocComment: ContinueNode represents a {{continue}} action.

nodes.Name: RangeNode
nodes.DocComment: RangeNode represents a {{range}} action and its commands.

nodes.Name: WithNode
nodes.DocComment: WithNode represents a {{with}} action and its commands.

nodes.Name: TemplateNode
nodes.DocComment: TemplateNode represents a {{template}} action.

Fields.Name: Line
Fields.DocComment: The line number in the input. Deprecated: Kept for compatibility.

Fields.Name: Pipe
Fields.DocComment: The command to evaluate as dot for the template.
